articles.title: Canva Now Lets Users Turn Off Generative AI Features
articles.summary: Canva has introduced settings that let free and paid users disable generative AI tools, including Magic Write, Magic Design, Magic Edit, Dream Lab, and Canva Code. Non-generative features such as Background Remover and Magic Grab remain available because they manipulate existing content rather than create new material. A separate preference reduces AI-generated templates and graphics in search results, prioritizing human-created content without guaranteeing that AI material disappears entirely.

articles.title: Big Changes to the Adobe Fonts Website
articles.summary: Adobe Fonts' biggest website upgrade in years merges search and browsing into one interface that filters 36,000 fonts by OpenType features and variable axes. A new AI recommendation page suggests fonts matching the mood of uploaded inspiration images, even ones without any text. Family pages now also show glyph maps and illustrated OpenType feature breakdowns.

articles.title: Docker Rebrand 2026: New Logo, Colors, and Strategy Explained
articles.summary: Docker has introduced a new visual identity and the positioning "Run on Trust," reflecting its expansion from application containers toward secure execution environments for autonomous AI agents. The redesign simplifies its recognizable whale logo into a containment-inspired symbol, replaces Docker Blue with a more violet-toned blue, and introduces GT Planar and GT Standard Mono typography. A darker website and expanded color palette accompany the strategic shift, positioning Docker as infrastructure for safely running both traditional applications and AI agents.

articles.title: Should You Actually Add AI to That? A Four-Question Audit for Product Teams
articles.summary: Adding AI helps only when what it returns in saved effort, caught errors, or consistency outweighs what users spend learning and verifying it. This post presents a four-question audit that asks whether the feature cuts total effort, beats the current method, lets users catch errors, and preserves verification skills after a year. A benefits-appeals tool became worthwhile once rescoped from drafting determinations to surfacing relevant provisions.

articles.title: It's official: creatives are using AI daily, but most aren't making extra money from it
articles.summary: Envato's survey of 1,033 creatives across 103 countries found that 87% use AI at work and 58% use it daily, although increased productivity rarely translates into higher earnings. Among creatives who report working faster with AI, only one in four see a financial benefit, while 53% of AI users have used AI on important client work without disclosing it. Taste and judgment ranked as the most valuable skills at 53%, followed by craft at 49%, while prompting fell to last place among eight skills at 19%.

articles.title: Design by Playground
articles.summary: AI coding agents are making it practical for designers to create temporary, purpose-built design tools instead of relying exclusively on general-purpose applications like Figma. These interactive playgrounds let designers manipulate variables, compare alternatives, and test real content, animation, loading states, and edge cases directly in the environment where the software will run. Agents can build them in minutes, so playgrounds can be created for individual design questions and discarded afterward, with successful decisions exported as code or design tokens.

articles.summary: Nameshot gives every new screenshot a proper name, right on your Mac.

articles.title: The Multiplier Effect: How Authoring Tools Can Transform Web Accessibility
articles.summary: Website builders and content management systems could multiply web accessibility by prompting for alt text and offering only WCAG-conforming options. With 74% of new web pages in April 2025 containing AI-generated content, well-designed AI could improve accessibility while poor implementations multiply barriers. W3C is updating its decade-old Authoring Tool Accessibility Guidelines and invites anyone interested to join the ATAG Community Group.

articles.title: Omoi's identity for Eclipse Space looks back to the Apollo program
articles.summary: Stockholm-based Omoi has developed an identity for satellite infrastructure company Eclipse Space inspired by the optimism, engineering, and visual language of NASA's Apollo program. The system combines a custom Eclipse Space Display typeface, Gorton-inspired interface labels, vibrant space-themed colors, and interactive website buttons modeled on the Apollo Guidance Computer's physical keys. Its distinctive solar corona symbol is generated through a custom tool developed with Claude Code, producing unique variations that follow consistent visual rules and reinforce the company's positioning around independent ownership of satellite networks.

articles.title: This non-alcoholic aperitif packaging was made with real plants, sunlight, and embossed glass
articles.summary: LOVE. has refreshed the identity and packaging of non-alcoholic aperitif Everleaf, combining sustainable glassmaking with botanical illustrations created through traditional cyanotype photography. The redesigned bottles use 100% post-consumer recycled glass, weigh 23% less than their predecessors, and feature embossed acacia leaves alongside a refined wordmark. Real plants exposed onto light-sensitive paper produce distinctive illustrations for the Forest, Mountain, and Marine varieties, connecting each product's ingredients to its visual identity.

articles.title: More Liquid Glass refinements being tested in iOS 27.3 beta
articles.summary: Apple is testing a subtler Liquid Glass effect in iOS 27.3 that restores the softer fading of scrolling content beneath navigation bars.

articles.title: Does NVIDIA Need a New Logo as Well as a New CEO?
articles.summary: After Jensen Huang's resignation, NVIDIA's 2006 logo, with its wonky eye and lime-green palette, looks ripe for a careful evolution that keeps two decades of recognition.

articles.title: Suno Now Lets You Make AI Videos for Your AI Music
articles.summary: Suno's new Visuals feature generates images and 15-second videos that sync automatically with its AI songs, including lipsynced lyrics, on web, iOS, and Android.
